Concept UI — Hörmann

Everything here is pixel-exact at the game's real 960×540 and uses only values from brand/BRAND_SYSTEM.md and the live theme token files.

The HUD artboard is drawn over a real gameplay capture with the current HUD switched off, so it can be compared directly against a screenshot of the implementation.

Read this as the target, not the plan.

The point of a concept is that the implementation fails against it. Where Phaser cannot reach this, the gap gets written down rather than quietly designed away.
